Early-career DevOps engineer focused on cloud-native infrastructure automation and container orchestration.

DevOps Engineer, Accenture — Sep 2025 - Present
At Accenture, implemented automated infrastructure provisioning for a customer-facing microservices platform. Designed Terraform modules to provision VPCs, subnets, and IAM roles in AWS, reducing environment setup time by ~60%. Built and maintained Kubernetes clusters for production and staging, using Helm charts to package and deploy services and to manage configuration drift. Containerized applications with Docker and improved CI/CD pipelines to achieve faster, repeatable deployments. Led Linux server hardening and troubleshooting for build agents and runners. Documented runbooks and architecture decisions in Confluence and collaborated with cross-functional teams to streamline incident response.

Skills: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Docker, Linux, Helm, Confluence
